reason: Upload-only official API (https://api.autocosmos.cl/DocsV3): Autocosmos Chile API V3 with public docs (same platform as .com.ar/.com.mx) for dealer listing management; credentials on request. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
